Chapter 7 - Classes and Methods / CyberItem

ICyberItem

Initializes this Cyberdog item. 
void ICyberItem ();
DISCUSSION
The superclass implementation of this method calls InitRefCntObject.

If you subclass CyberItem and override this method, your override must call its inherited method.
